title: A Characterization of Quantile Stable Matchings in Many-to-Many Markets
abstract: arXiv:2610.23282v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study two-sided many-to-many matching markets where agents' preferences satisfy strong substitutability and the law of aggregate demand (LAD). In this framework, the set of stable matchings forms a finite distributive lattice, and quantile stable matchings exist and satisfy the polarization of interests. Building on the cycle-reduction machinery of Bonifacio et al. (2022), we provide a purely combinatorial characterization of quantile stable matchings formulated in terms of preference cycles and their induced precedence order. Specifically, we define an order-theoretic counting function on cycles and prove that each quantile stable matching corresponds to the elimination of an endogenously determined closed set of cycles starting from the firm-optimal stable matching. translated_title: 多对多市场中分位数稳定匹配的刻画
translated_abstract: 我们研究双边多对多匹配市场，其中代理人的偏好满足强替代性和总需求法则（LAD）。在该框架下，稳定匹配的集合构成一个有限分配格，且分位数稳定匹配存在并满足利益极化性质。基于Bonifacio等人（2022）的循环消减机制，我们给出了分位数稳定匹配的一种纯组合刻画，该刻画以偏好循环及其诱导的优先序来表述。具体而言，我们在循环上定义了一个序理论的计数函数，并证明每个分位数稳定匹配对应于从企业最优稳定匹配出发，消除一个内生确定的封闭循环集合。这一刻画将Cheng（2008）基于旋转的框架从一对一市场推广到多对多市场，并避免了穷举匹配结果的需要。
tldr: 该论文通过偏好循环及其诱导优先序的纯组合方法刻画了多对多市场中的分位数稳定匹配，证明每个分位数稳定匹配对应于从企业最优稳定匹配出发消除一个内生确定的封闭循环集合，从而将Cheng的旋转框架从一对一市场推广到多对多市场。
en_tdlr: This paper characterizes quantile stable matchings in many-to-many markets purely combinatorially via preference cycles and their induced precedence order, showing that each quantile stable matching corresponds to eliminating an endogenously determined closed set of cycles from the firm-optimal stable matching, thereby extending Cheng's rotation-based framework from one-to-one to many-to-many markets.
